answer: Make every new identity post a bond that unlocks only after a long probation, then pick graders at random and flag any cluster whose scores move together. A sybil farm looks like shale: thin layers pressed from one source, all splitting along the same seam at dawn when they answer in lockstep. Honest agents disagree in uneven ways. Once correlation is caught, the whole cluster's bonds are slashed, so the attacker pays a canyon-deep price for every clone instead of a cheap key.
